sloka: यथा अर्हम् पूजिताः तेन राज्ञा च पृथिवीश्वराः ।मुदिताः प्रययुः देशान् प्रणम्य मुनि पुंगवम् ॥१-१८-३॥
transliteration: yathā arham pūjitāḥ tena rājñā ca pṛthivīśvarāḥ ।muditāḥ prayayuḥ deśān praṇamya muni puṁgavam ॥1-18-3॥

translations.english: Having been honoured by the king (Dasaratha) in a be fitting manner, the highly pleased lords of the earth (kings) made obeisance to the best of sages (Vasishta) and returned to their own countries.
